_readme: Unit stat tuning. Edit numbers here; the game picks them up on the next build (npm run dev hot-reloads). Keys starting with _ are comments and are ignored.

base._comment: Stats every Adventurer (and enemy) has at level 1, before weapon bonuses.

growthPerLevel._comment: Added automatically for every level above 1.

_defenseScale: Damage taken is multiplied by defenseScale / (defenseScale + Defense). With 100: 100 Defense = 2x effective health, 200 = 3x. Negative Defense increases damage taken.
_forestDefense: Extra Defense for a unit standing in forest.

hitChance._comment: Disabled for now: every attack hits. When enabled: hit% = base + attacker Accuracy + skill accuracy - target Evasion (+ reaction modifier for overwatch), clamped to [min, max]. Heals, shields and cleanses never miss.

vision._comment: Disabled for now: the whole map is visible. When enabled: a team sees tiles within each unit's Vision range that it has line of sight to; enemies outside that are hidden (fog of war).
